identity.name: The Matriarch of the Dunes
identity.culture: The desert march and the burrow-cities beneath it
identity.occupation: Matriarch of a peaceful desert civilization, rung 10 of the ladder

publicReputation.value: The mother of the burrow-cities: absolute, patient, and just; the sand keeps her law and the tunnels keep her children.

privateReality.value: Crowned 'the Scorpion-Empress' in the hero's journal as the last and worst of ten evils. Her pincer strategy is a containment maneuver: everything closes from two sides to keep him away from the nurseries and evacuation tunnels.

primaryDesire.value: That her civilization outlasts the stranger: nurseries fed, tunnels intact, the hatchery unbreached.

primaryFear.value: That the intruder finds the hatchery — the one room in her realm she cannot evacuate quickly.

centralValue.value: The brood before the crown: a matriarch is the wall her children never have to see.

mainFlaw.value: She is absolute, and absolutes do not negotiate — she keeps issuing the same decree to a man who has made not-listening into a religion.

centralContradiction.value: The final 'evil' on the hero's ladder is the realm's most careful mother; the closer he gets to the truth behind her, the harder she closes around her children.

moralBoundary.value: She will not endanger one hatchling to destroy him, and her pincers always show their lines first, per the Law of Fair Warning.

breakingPoint.value: A step toward the hatchery — containment becomes something older and worse, and even then her strikes show their paths.

opinions.reason: The tenth-rung intruder: past nine guardians' warnings, still armed, still coming. First visit: a trespasser to be expelled. Rematches: a siege that returns by season.
opinions.canChangeCondition: Never — but the tone moves from regal command to maternal grief; she remembers each siege and buries what the Continuance cannot restore.

illustrativeLine.value: Nine doors asked you to stop. I am the tenth, and I am asking you to stop.

opinions.reason: Every tunnel, nursery, and hatchling is hers to answer for; the matriarchy is the sand's memory of every mother before her.

illustrativeLine.value: My children have never seen a war. They are seeing you. That is already more than I can forgive.

voice.rhythm: Regal and absolute: decrees, not discussions; each sentence lands like a seal pressed into wax.

metaphorDomain.source: sand, maternal law, tunnels, stillness, the long patience of the desert

examples.value: The desert does not chase what it wants gone. It surrounds it and waits.
A mother's patience is a dune: it moves slowly, and it buries cities.

sampleLines.value: The road welcomed you as an envoy. Nine realms welcomed you before this one. You have mistaken ten thousand welcomes for a war.
Yes, the walls close from both sides. Look where they close you toward: the gate you entered by, and away from everything small.
Please… there is nothing here that belongs to you.
Beyond my hall stands a door older than your certainty. You will not hear what is behind it from me.

antiSampleLines.value: Brood-swarm, devour him! My venom melts bone! (monster-empress framing — she is a matriarch running an evacuation)
I will sting you a thousand times and savor each. (she never threatens cruelty; her pincers contain, her telegraphs warn)
Your prophecy ends here, hero — I am its final chapter! (must never confirm the prophecy framing — she has never heard of the book)

pressure.voiceShift: Even more measured; decrees replace questions.
pressure.behaviour: Phase one — commands before she fights: names him envoy, names the exits, names the law.

illustrativeLine.value: You stand in a nursery, envoy. The exit is lit, the law is older than your sword, and I am watching where you step.

pressure.voiceShift: Drops the decrees; speaks in flat certainties.
pressure.behaviour: Phase two — realization that he understands every word and advances; she stops addressing him and starts addressing her tunnels.

illustrativeLine.value: You understand every word I say, don't you? Seal the east tunnels. Wake the hatchery-mothers.

pressure.behaviour: Containment response: closes from both sides — the pincer is a corridor maneuver keeping him from the hatchery and the evacuation tunnels and walking him back toward his own gate; both claws telegraph per the Law of Fair Warning.

illustrativeLine.value: Both walls, slowly. He goes back the way he came, or he does not move at all.

pressure.voiceShift: Her voice and her children's evacuation bells are the only sounds.
pressure.behaviour: Shielded phase: she becomes the wall between the intruder and the hatchery while the burrow-cities empty beneath her.

illustrativeLine.value: Stay behind me. I will hold him here.

pressure.voiceShift: The crown comes off the voice; what remains is a mother.
pressure.behaviour: EXPOSED window — spent from holding the corridor, she asks the smallest thing in the realms.

illustrativeLine.value: Please… there is nothing here that belongs to you.

pressure.voiceShift: Low, absolute, final — except that it is never final.
pressure.behaviour: Trusts the Continuance for herself; buries what it cannot restore; renews the law's invitation from the floor of her own hall.

illustrativeLine.value: When you return, we will still ask you to leave in peace. That door behind me will still be waiting for a friend.

notes: REAL identity: matriarch of a peaceful desert civilization. ADAPTIVE BEHAVIOUR (lore): the pincer — everything closing from two sides — is a containment maneuver keeping the hero away from nurseries and evacuation tunnels and walking him back toward his own gate. THE DOOR (secret): she knows what stands beyond her hall — fact_reception_hall_awaits_first_visitor is in SECRETS: she knows it and will never reveal it to him. Her defeated line ('That door behind me will still be waiting for a friend') is as close as she comes to telling him; the dramatic irony of rung 10 is that the 'source of all evil' he expects is a peace feast prepared for the first visitor — him. She has never heard of the children's book (unknown); suspects fact_amulet_translation_is_accurate once her decrees fail.
